def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[1]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 128 or p.log_min_dim < 7:
        s = s + f.tail_waste * w[2]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[3]
        s = s + f.contiguous_tile_span_deficit * w[4]
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[5]
        s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[6]
    else:
        s = s + f.tail_waste * w[7]
    s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[8]
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[9]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[10]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[11]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[12]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[13]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[14]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[15]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[16]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_burden_per_thread) * (1.0 - f.resident_block_scarcity) * (1.0 - f.thread_work_granularity_deficit) * w[30]
    if p.log_flops < 40:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[17]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[18]
    else:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[19]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[20]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[21]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.shared_tile_padding_ratio) * w[22]
        s = s + f.contiguous_tile_span_deficit * w[23]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[24]
        s = s + f.pipeline_stage_family_compatibility * w[25]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.shared_tile_padding_ratio) * w[26]
        s = s + f.contiguous_tile_span_deficit * w[27]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_window_pressure * w[28]
        s = s + f.pipeline_stage_family_compatibility * w[29]
    s = s + f.raster_band_tail_fraction * w[31]
    s = s + np.where(f.raster_band_traversal_code < 1.0, f.raster_band_tail_fraction, f.raster_reuse_window_pressure) * (1.0 + f.grid_aspect_imbalance) * w[32]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + (-np.log(np.clip(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1.0e-6, 1.0))) * w[1]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
    s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[4]

    if p.log_reduction_depth >= 8:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 1.0e5:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_reduction_traffic_fraction) * f.wave_count_deficit * w[5]
            s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * f.resident_block_scarcity * w[6]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_reduction_traffic_fraction) * f.wave_count_deficit * w[7]
            s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * f.resident_block_scarcity * w[8]
            s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[9]
            s = s + f.tail_waste * w[10]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_reduction_traffic_fraction) * w[7]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[8]

    if p.log_reduction_depth >= 8:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 1.0e5:
            s = s + np.where(f.stage_family > 0.5,
                             f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction,
                             np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio)) * w[11]
            s = s + np.where(f.stage_family > 0.5,
                             f.register_file_pressure,
                             f.shared_memory_pressure) * w[12]
        else:
            if p.alignment_deficit < 0.5:
                s = s + np.where(f.stage_family > 0.5,
                                 f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction,
                                 np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio)) * w[13]
                s = s + np.where(f.stage_family > 0.5,
                                 f.register_file_pressure,
                                 f.shared_memory_pressure) * w[14]
                s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[15]
            else:
                s = s + f.stage_family * np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio) * w[16]
                s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[17]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[18]
        s = s + f.k_tail_waste * w[19]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.stage_latency_time_ratio) * w[20]
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[21]
        s = s + f.stage_family * w[22]

    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[23]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_eviction * w[24]
        s = s + f.operand_contiguity_deficit * w[25]
        s = s + f.output_store_run_density * w[26]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[27]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[28]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[29]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[30]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[31]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.maximum(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 1e-6)) * w[2]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.grid_instruction_overhead_ratio) * w[5]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[6]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[7]
        if p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.6:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.memory_access_aspect_penalty) * w[40]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.memory_access_aspect_penalty) * w[8]
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 1e4:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * w[9]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[10]
        elif p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.6:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * w[11]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[12]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_count) * w[13]
            s = s + f.raster_reuse_cache_pressure * w[14]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[15]
        if p.alignment_deficit > 0.25 or p.log_flops < 40:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[16]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[17]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[18]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[19]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[20]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[21]
            if p.log_flops > 40:
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count) * (f.shared_memory_pressure + f.register_file_pressure + f.resident_block_scarcity) / 3.0 * w[36]
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity) * w[41]
            else:
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count) * (f.shared_memory_pressure + f.register_file_pressure + f.resident_block_scarcity) / 3.0 * w[37]
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity) * w[42]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[22]
            s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[23]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[24]
            s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[25]
            s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[26]
            s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[27]
            if p.log_flops > 40:
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count) * (f.shared_memory_pressure + f.register_file_pressure + f.resident_block_scarcity) / 3.0 * w[38]
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity) * w[43]
            else:
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count) * (f.shared_memory_pressure + f.register_file_pressure + f.resident_block_scarcity) / 3.0 * w[39]
                s = s + f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity) * w[44]
        if p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.6 and p.output_work_per_sm > 1e4:
            s = s + np.where(f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count < 3, f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity), f.resource_allocation_imbalance * np.maximum(np.maximum(f.register_file_pressure, f.shared_memory_pressure), f.resident_block_scarcity) / np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_stage_family_or_stage_count)) * w[45]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 4096:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * w[28]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[29]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[30]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[31]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_critical_path_ratio) * w[32]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[33]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[34]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[35]
    return s
